scenarios.title: Persisted ore before hull-local credit
steps: Start only an isolated disposable pinned EveJS mining world with the strict cargo flag ON
Witness miner target lock, real mining module and source rock depletion
Measure nativeNpcStore cargoID and local hull cargoID across two ticks
expected: Only a positive native-stored cargoID can appear as hull cargo
Native store quantity and local quantity exactly match
requiredEvidence: hull nativeCargoItems same ID and quantity

scenarios.title: Native cargo ID allocator refuses new row
steps: Fault-inject an allocateCargoID failure on disposable local storage
Allow one legitimate stock mining yield callback
Verify hull cargo and native store after failed allocator
expected: No negative cargoID and no new local stack

scenarios.title: Write acknowledged failure
steps: Fault-inject nativeNpcStore upsert success=false
Allow one native mining yield callback in isolated scene
Verify no local hull credit or automatic repeated grant
expected: No positive hull cargo quantity from the failed write
Unknown write is operator repair, not an automatic retry

scenarios.title: Write commits then throws before hull mutation
steps: Write native ore row but inject exception before write RPC returns
Capture source row ID and unchanged local hull view
Run another tick and check for duplicate writes
expected: Exactly the original native row remains without duplicated local cargo
Fail-closed in-memory repair state holds until reconciliation

scenarios.title: Restart after confirmed native write with lost hull view
steps: Persist one stock miner native store cargo row and lose its in-memory cargo snapshot in disposable world
Restart and restore original physical miner ID
Attempt ordinary mining yield for same ore type
expected: Existing type/owner native row blocks an unrelated newly allocated cargoID
No free resource minted through restart replay

scenarios.title: Existing stack quantity, owner and type divergence
steps: Load known durable native ore with a single cargoID
Inject corrupted source quantity or owner in disposable test
Run strict mining cargo callback
expected: Mismatch cannot increment local hull cargo or overwrite native owner
Operator repair names the source conflict

scenarios.title: No loss of native haul custody downstream
steps: Use authentic mined ore with positive cargoID
Transfer miner source cargo to original native hauler using existing cargo custody bridge
Dock physically at valid real station and reconcile complete warehouse manifest
expected: Same cargoID moves through proper committed custody chain exactly once
No second mining, hauling or warehouse value writer
requiredEvidence: miner to hauler native cargo IDs
source debit and warehouse COMMITTED receipt

scenarios.title: Two clients and failback OFF behavior
steps: Connect two authorized clients to disposable EveJS Perimeter 30000144
Observe physical miner and cargo progression with strict flag ON
Disable flag in separately reset disposable environment and confirm pinned original behavior
expected: Same physical NPC and cargoID visible to both clients
Default flag OFF does not change upstream source semantics
